title: Adopt a repo-local lore skill: drop skill_source = plugin while opum-lore is disabled in this checkout (DEC-238 a1)
description:
Ruling DEC-238 (a1), opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:47:40Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a1), verbatim: "while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a REPO-LOCAL generated SKILL.md. The 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting is left untouched, whatever its reason. A repository returns to skill_source = "plugin" only once the plugin is measured enabled in its own checkout. Each plugin-source repository with the plugin off in its checkout drops the skill_source = "plugin" line, runs `lore agents`, and confirms --check exits 0, as its own tier-2 decision, scheduled in the plan."

MEASURED in this checkout at 2026-10-25T06:50Z, not relayed:
- .lore/config.toml:36 on origin/dev reads `skill_source = "plugin"`.
- .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored, mtime 2026-10-20 22:20) sets `"opum-lore@opum": false`.
- `claude plugin list`: opum-lore@opum 0.14.1, scope user, Status disabled.
- `lore agents --check` exits 0 but reports `absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` and `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user`, with the remedy `claude plugin enable opum-lore@opum --scope user`.
- There is no .claude/skills/ directory in the checkout at all, so no lore skill resolves. The finding is real.

TRAP: exit 0 is not the gate. lore agents --check already exits 0 in this broken state, so "confirms --check exits 0" cannot distinguish fixed from unfixed. The signal is the absent-plugin-sourced / plugin-disabled line disappearing from the report.

AUTHORITY: this edits this repository own governing files, so applying it is a tier-2 decision -- the operator or this session, never a relayed instruction. Filing the task is what was asked; the edit itself waits for the plan.

COUPLING THAT MUST BE AGREED, NOT SMUGGLED: CLAUDE.md carries the hand-written sentence "The lore and quest skills ship as the `opum-lore` and `opum-quest` plugins ... A copy under `.claude/skills/` is drift". Once a repo-local lore skill is generated, that sentence is false for lore. It is hand-written prose outside the managed markers, so reconciling it is a separate tier-2 edit that needs agreement before the PR opens, not a silent rewrite inside this task.

NOT TOUCHED: .claude/settings.local.json stays exactly as it is -- the ruling leaves the 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting untouched whatever its reason.

OUT OF SCOPE: the quest side. For the record, opum-quest@opum is also disabled here (0.13.0, scope user), but `quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude` reports skill state current, and DEC-238 (a1) does not cover quest. If that asymmetry matters it belongs to opum-doc, not to this task.

NOT STARTED: filed tracker-only; the fix waits for the day plan to schedule it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: .lore/config.toml contains no skill_source setting, and no other live line in the repository sets skill_source = plugin for lore
lore agents has been run and a repo-local .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md exists, generated between managed markers with no hand edits
lore agents --check reports neither an absent-plugin-sourced finding nor a plugin-disabled line for opum-lore, and exits 0
Any change to the CLAUDE.md skills sentence is outside the managed Quest block and was agreed as a tier-2 edit before the PR opened, as recorded in the PR body
.claude/settings.local.json is unmodified and still reads "opum-lore@opum": false, and the PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity
